about: The cells of ../../EXPERIMENT.md 7 (DRAFT: n and the switch values are fixed at the pre-registration prereg/gin-control-v1). Input of hold_gc.sh (what to run), check_cells_gc.py (the cross-check with section 3) and score_gc.py (the planned scored trials per cell@build). 'rows' are section 7's 26 table rows (25 after the 2026-10-22 trim, 27 before it; the GPU-hang cell added 2026-10-23); 'cells' the cell@build runs (kind rs -> run_gc.sh through cells_gc.sh); 'holds' the main-run holds C1-C3, C5-C11 (C4 held only the removed tcp contrast cells) and the pilot holds P0-P4 (never scored; P4 runs the pilot-only cell of 'pilot_cells'); 'regression' gin-mirror's non-cost cells by name and env at @gc, and at @gct only the one control cell of regression.builds.gct.cells; 'cost' the probe cost family (run_cost_gc.sh); 'local' the CPU-only items (no cluster). env values are run_gc.sh's variables (R<r>_ENV, SPARE_ENV: the library's test switches of that process). Each trial's launchers run with its cell's launcher_env (EXPERIMENT 5: one launcher per node per trial since 2026-10-22, started by run_gc.sh). Every TODO names the phase or the pilot that fixes it.
